newsitem.title: GERMANY: Commerzbank up on renewed merger talk.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank up on renewed merger talk.

text.p: Shares in Commerzbank AG, Germany's third largest bank, rose against the market trend on Tuesday, with dealers saying renewed merger talk was propelling the stock.

Commerzbank hit a year high of 38.80 marks during bourse trade and ended the session up 57 pfennigs, or 1.5 percent, at 38.67 marks. The DAX index of top German shares ended down 1.42 percent at 2,815.13 points.
Commerzbank, with drug manufacturer Schering, was one of just two DAX stocks in positive territory.
Dealers were unable to pin the rise to a specific rumour, but said there was general speculation that there may be a single buyer interested in the stock.
Shares in Commerzbank have raced ahead this year on merger speculation sparked in July when Deutsche Bank said it had bought a 5.21 percent stake in Bayerische Vereinsbank .
In mid-November Commerzbank surged on rumours a single large investor was buying up its shares, talk the bank moved to quash.
